x-groups.title: Discovery
x-groups.description: How each collection's fields become a stream's columns.

uri.description: A MongoDB connection string, mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://. cdc needs a replica set or a sharded cluster.
uri.title: Connection string

database.description: The database whose collections are offered as streams.
database.title: Database

collections.description: The collections to offer as streams. Empty: every collection in the database but views, time series and system collections.
collections.title: Collections

sampleSize.description: Documents discovery samples at random from each collection to find its fields and their types. 0: every document, so that a read never meets a field discovery didn't declare. A sample can miss a rare field, and a read that meets it fails and starts again until a sample finds it: set 0, or packed, for collections with rare fields.
sampleSize.title: Sample size

chunkDocuments.description: Documents per query, in _id order; each chunk ends at a resume point. A cdc read also ends a resume point at this many changes.
chunkDocuments.title: Chunk documents

packed.description: Read each document whole: every stream is _id and data, a JSON column with the document in canonical Extended JSON, instead of a column per top-level field. Discovery reads no documents, and no read fails on a new field. For collections whose fields vary too much to declare.
packed.title: Packed documents
